<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue";
import { cn, buttonVariants } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useAlertDialogContext } from "./use-alert-dialog-context";

const props = defineProps<{ class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>();
const attrs = useAttrs();
const api = useAlertDialogContext();

type AttrValue = string | number | boolean | null | undefined | ((event: MouseEvent) => void);

const actionAttrs = computed(() => {
  const { onClick, ...rest } = attrs as Record<string, AttrValue>;
  return rest;
});

const handleClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
  api.value.setOpen(false);
  const onClick = (attrs as Record<string, AttrValue>).onClick;
  if (typeof onClick !== "function") return;
  onClick?.(event);
};
</script>

<template>
  <button
    v-bind="actionAttrs"
    type="button"
    :class="cn(buttonVariants(), props.class)"
    @click="handleClick"
  >
    <slot />
  </button>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue";
import { alertDialogCancelVariants, cn, buttonVariants } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useAlertDialogContext } from "./use-alert-dialog-context";

const props = defineProps<{ class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>();
const attrs = useAttrs();
const api = useAlertDialogContext();

const cancelAttrs = computed(() => {
  const { onClick, ...rest } = attrs as Record<string, object>;
  return rest;
});

const handleClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
  api.value.setOpen(false);
  const onClick = (attrs as Record<string, object>).onClick as
    | ((event: MouseEvent) => void)
    | undefined;
  onClick?.(event);
};
</script>

<template>
  <button
    v-bind="cancelAttrs"
    type="button"
    :class="cn(buttonVariants({ variant: 'outline' }), alertDialogCancelVariants(), props.class)"
    @click="handleClick"
  >
    <slot />
  </button>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { type HTMLAttributes, type Component } from "vue";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Primitive } from '../../primitive';
import { useAlertDialogContext } from "./use-alert-dialog-context";

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    as?: string | Component;
    asChild?: boolean;
    class?: HTMLAttributes["class"];
  }>(),
  {
    as: "button",
  }
);

const api = useAlertDialogContext();
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    :as="props.as"
    :as-child="props.asChild"
    v-bind="api.getTriggerProps()"
    :class="cn(props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </Primitive>
</template>

<view class="{{className}}">
  <!-- Trigger (optional) -->
  <view 
    wx:if="{{showTrigger}}"
    bindtap="onTriggerTap"
  >
    <slot name="trigger"></slot>
  </view>

  <!-- Backdrop -->
  <view 
    wx:if="{{api.open}}"
    class="alert-dialog-backdrop"
    bindtap="onBackdropTap"
    data-state="{{api.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}}"
  ></view>

  <!-- Dialog Content -->
  <view 
    wx:if="{{api.open}}"
    id="{{api.contentProps.id}}"
    class="alert-dialog-content"
    role="{{role}}"
    data-state="{{api.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}}"
  >
    <!-- Header -->
    <view class="alert-dialog-header">
      <text 
        id="{{api.titleProps.id}}"
        class="alert-dialog-title"
      >
        <slot name="title">{{title}}</slot>
      </text>
      <view 
        wx:if="{{showClose}}"
        class="alert-dialog-close" 
        bindtap="onCloseTap"
      >×</view>
    </view>

    <!-- Body -->
    <view 
      id="{{api.descriptionProps.id}}"
      class="alert-dialog-body"
    >
      <slot name="description">{{description}}</slot>
    </view>

    <!-- Footer -->
    <view class="alert-dialog-footer">
      <slot name="footer">
        <view class="alert-dialog-actions">
          <view 
            class="alert-dialog-cancel-btn" 
            bindtap="onCancelTap"
          >
            {{cancelText || '取消'}}
          </view>
          <view 
            class="alert-dialog-confirm-btn" 
            bindtap="onConfirmTap"
          >
            {{confirmText || '确认'}}
          </view>
        </view>
      </slot>
    </view>
  </view>
</view>
